title: Greatest Hits
description: The most recognizable masterpieces across the whole collection — start here.

items.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)"
items.description_narrative: Katsushika Hokusai's iconic color woodblock print, 'The Great Wave,' captures a colossal wave cresting over three fishing boats, threatening to engulf them amidst a turbulent sea. In the distance, the serene form of Mount Fuji stands against the sky, anchoring this dramatic scene from his famous series 'Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji.'
items.tags: great wave, mount fuji, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, ocean, dramatic, japanese landscape

items.title: Venus de Milo
items.description_narrative: The Venus de Milo is an iconic ancient Greek marble statue, renowned for its depiction of the goddess Aphrodite. Discovered on the island of Milos, its missing arms contribute to its enduring mystery and beauty.
items.tags: greek, hellenistic, sculpture, marble, goddess, aphrodite, classical, nude, antiquity

items.title: Pietà
items.description_narrative: This monumental marble sculpture depicts the Virgin Mary cradling the body of Jesus after his crucifixion, a poignant representation of sorrow and maternal love. Carved by Michelangelo, it is renowned for its harmonious composition and idealized forms, conveying profound emotion through a highly polished finish.
items.tags: sculpture, renaissance, christian art, religious, marble, virgin mary, jesus, lamentation, italian

items.title: De Nachtwacht
items.description_narrative: Rembrandt's 'The Night Watch' depicts the company of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq and Lieutenant Willem van Ruytenburch moving out, renowned for its dramatic use of light and shadow. This monumental group portrait is a masterpiece of the Dutch Golden Age, celebrated for its dynamic composition and psychological depth.
items.tags: dutch golden age, group portrait, baroque, militia, dramatic, masterpiece, civic guard

items.title: The Thinker
items.description_narrative: Auguste Rodin's iconic sculpture, "The Thinker," depicts a monumental nude male figure seated in deep contemplation. Originally conceived to crown his ambitious "Gates of Hell," this powerful work has become a universal symbol of intellectual ponderance and human struggle.
items.tags: contemplation, sculpture, male nude, symbolism, monumental, pensive, realism

items.title: Migrant Mother
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures Florence Owens Thompson and her children in a pea-pickers' camp during the Great Depression, embodying the widespread struggles of the era. Lange's powerful composition emphasizes the family's resilience and the profound human impact of economic hardship.
items.tags: poverty, migration, family, mother, documentary photography, social realism, hardship, iconic

items.title: Water Lilies
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet's 'Water Lilies' captures the ephemeral play of light and reflection on the surface of his water garden at Giverny. This painting is part of an extensive series, through which Monet explored the subtle changes in nature across different times of day and seasons.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, nature, impressionism, french art, tranquil, reflections, garden

items.title: Winged Victory of Samothrace
items.description_narrative: This monumental marble sculpture depicts Nike, the Greek goddess of victory, poised dramatically as if descending from the sky. Discovered in the Sanctuary of the Great Gods on Samothrace, it celebrates a naval triumph and is renowned for its dynamic composition and masterful drapery.
items.tags: ancient greek, hellenistic, sculpture, nike, victory, marble, dramatic, movement

items.title: I Want You for U.S. Army
items.description_narrative: James Montgomery Flagg's iconic "I Want You for U.S. Army" poster features Uncle Sam pointing directly at the viewer, an impactful call to enlist. Created in 1917, this powerful image became one of the most recognizable symbols of American military recruitment and patriotism.
items.tags: propaganda, recruitment, world war i, uncle sam, illustration, american, patriotism, poster art

items.title: The Kiss
items.description_narrative: Auguste Rodin's iconic sculpture, "The Kiss," captures a passionate embrace between two figures. The work is celebrated for its sensual depiction of human emotion and physical connection.
items.tags: sculpture, marble, love, passion, embrace, sensuality, Symbolism, French art

items.title: Mask of Tutankhamun
items.description_narrative: This iconic funerary mask covered the head of the mummy of the Eighteenth Dynasty pharaoh Tutankhamun, crafted to preserve his likeness for eternity. Fashioned from solid gold and inlaid with vibrant semi-precious stones and glass, it remains a globally recognized masterpiece of ancient Egyptian artistry.
items.tags: ancient egypt, pharaoh, funerary art, gold, royal, burial, treasure, new kingdom

items.title: Pillars of Creation
items.agent_name: SCIENCE: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; IMAGE PROCESSING: Joseph DePasquale (STScI), Anton M. Koekemoer (STScI), Alyssa Pagan (STScI)
items.description_narrative: This iconic astronomical image captures towering structures of interstellar gas and dust within the Eagle Nebula, where new stars are actively forming. These "pillars" are dense nurseries sculpted by the intense radiation and stellar winds from massive, hot, young stars.
items.tags: astronomy, nebula, star formation, cosmic, space, scientific, majestic

items.title: The Blue Marble
items.description_narrative: The Blue Marble is a celebrated photograph of Earth, captured from space during the Apollo 17 mission. This iconic image vividly showcases the full illuminated disk of our planet, displaying its oceans, landmasses, and cloud patterns.
items.tags: earth, space, photography, iconic, apollo, planet, global, view

items.title: Earthrise
items.agent_name: NASA / Goddard Space Flight Center / Arizona State University
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph, captured during the Apollo 8 mission, depicts Earth rising dramatically above the lunar horizon. It offers a profound view of our planet as a fragile, vibrant sphere in the vastness of space, shifting human perspective on our home.
items.tags: space, earth, moon, iconic, photography, apollo 8, scientific, 1960s

items.title: Great Sphinx of Giza
items.description_narrative: The Great Sphinx of Giza is an iconic limestone sculpture depicting a mythical creature with a lion's body and a human head. Standing on the Giza Plateau, it is believed to have been carved during the Old Kingdom of ancient Egypt, likely for Pharaoh Khafre.
items.tags: ancient egypt, colossal sculpture, giza, monument, sphinx, limestone, old kingdom

items.title: Rosetta Stone
items.description_narrative: This granodiorite stele features a decree issued by King Ptolemy V, inscribed in three distinct scripts: hieroglyphic, Demotic, and ancient Greek. Its multilingual text provided the crucial key for modern scholars to decipher ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.
items.tags: ancient Egypt, Ptolemaic, decree, inscription, hieroglyphs, multilingual, linguistic, historical artifact

items.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
items.description_narrative: Georges Seurat's monumental oil on canvas, "A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884," captures Parisians enjoying a leisurely afternoon on an island in the Seine. This iconic work is meticulously composed using the artist's groundbreaking pointillist technique, creating luminous color and form.
items.tags: sunday, leisure, park, pointillism, post-impressionism, Parisian life, serene, vibrant

items.title: Laocoön and His Sons
items.description_narrative: This monumental marble sculpture captures the dramatic struggle of the Trojan priest Laocoön and his two sons as they are attacked by sea serpents, a scene from the Trojan War myth. Its intricate composition and intense depiction of suffering exemplify Hellenistic art's mastery of human anatomy and emotion.
items.tags: hellenistic, classical, mythology, sculpture, struggle, suffering, ancient greek, dramatic

items.title: Ophelia
items.description_narrative: John Everett Millais's *Ophelia* vividly captures the tragic moment of Ophelia's drowning, as described in Shakespeare's *Hamlet*. The artwork is renowned for its meticulous detail in depicting the surrounding flora and Ophelia's ethereal pose, painted from a model floating in water.
items.tags: ophelia, shakespeare, pre-raphaelite, victorian art, tragedy, nature, detail, melancholy

items.title: Ghent Altarpiece: Adoration of the Mystic Lamb
items.description_narrative: Jan van Eyck's iconic Ghent Altarpiece, specifically the 'Adoration of the Mystic Lamb' panel, is a pivotal work in art history. This complex, multi-paneled artwork is renowned for its meticulous detail, vibrant colors, and profound theological narrative.
items.tags: religious art, altarpiece, early netherlandish, christianity, northern renaissance, adoration, sacred, detailed

items.title: The Lady of Shalott
items.description_narrative: John William Waterhouse's iconic painting depicts the tragic Lady of Shalott from Tennyson's poem, captured at the moment she leaves her island tower to face her doom. Her gaze fixed towards Camelot, she sits in a boat amidst unraveling tapestry threads, embodying a pivotal moment of fate and consequence.
items.tags: pre-raphaelite, victorian, painting, literature, arthurian legend, symbolism, tragic, romanticism

items.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
items.description_narrative: This monumental work captures the dramatic moment when Jesus Christ calls Matthew to abandon his life as a tax collector and follow him. Caravaggio's use of intense chiaroscuro and naturalism illuminates the figures, highlighting the spiritual encounter within a seemingly everyday setting.
items.tags: religious, biblical, baroque, chiaroscuro, tenebrism, dramatic, naturalism, calling

items.title: The Steerage
items.description_narrative: Alfred Stieglitz's 'The Steerage' captures European immigrants in the lowest deck of a transatlantic ship, a pivotal work in photographic history. It is celebrated for its modernist composition, emphasizing the interplay of lines, shapes, and textures over purely documentary narrative.
items.tags: photography, modernism, immigration, social commentary, early 20th century, New York, composition

items.title: Pale Blue Dot
items.description_narrative: The 'Pale Blue Dot' captures Earth as a tiny, distant speck, suspended within a vast ray of sunlight. This iconic image was taken by the Voyager 1 space probe from a record-setting distance, emphasizing humanity's place in the cosmos.
items.tags: earth, space, cosmos, astronomy, photograph, scientific, vastness, exploration

items.title: Buzz Aldrin on the Moon Apollo 11
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures astronaut Buzz Aldrin on the lunar surface during the historic Apollo 11 mission. It vividly portrays a human presence on the Moon, reflecting the immense achievement of space exploration.
items.tags: space exploration, moon landing, apollo 11, buzz aldrin, astronaut, historic, photography

items.title: Apollo 11 bootprint on the Moon
items.description_narrative: This iconic photograph captures Buzz Aldrin's bootprint on the lunar surface during the Apollo 11 mission. It stands as a powerful symbol of humanity's first steps on another celestial body and the achievement of space exploration.
items.tags: space, moon, bootprint, astronaut, apollo 11, lunar, historic, exploration

items.title: The Bedroom
items.description_narrative: Vincent van Gogh's 'The Bedroom' depicts his living space in the 'Yellow House' in Arles, France. The painting features vibrant colors and a distinctive perspective, inviting viewers into the artist's personal world.
items.tags: interior, bedroom, post-impressionism, vibrant, personal, arles

items.title: Moses
items.description_narrative: Michelangelo's monumental marble sculpture captures Moses in a moment of intense emotion, holding the Tablets of the Law. This powerful work was intended as a central figure for the tomb of Pope Julius II.
items.tags: biblical, high renaissance, sculpture, marble, monumental, old testament, italian

items.title: The Light of the World
items.description_narrative: William Holman Hunt's "The Light of the World" portrays Jesus Christ, lantern in hand, knocking on a heavily overgrown, doorless door, symbolizing a soul resistant to entry. This highly allegorical work, based on Revelation 3:20, is renowned for its rich symbolism and meticulous detail.
items.tags: religious, allegory, pre-raphaelite, jesus christ, symbolism, victorian, spiritual

items.title: Flaming June
items.description_narrative: Frederic Leighton's iconic work depicts a woman in a vibrant orange gown, asleep in a dream-like, contorted pose. Bathed in the golden light of a setting sun, the figure is positioned against a distant, serene Mediterranean seascape.
items.tags: sleeping woman, aestheticism, victorian art, classical, mediterranean, orange, opulence, repose

items.title: Moulin Rouge: La Goulue
items.description_narrative: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec's iconic poster, "Moulin Rouge: La Goulue," vividly advertises the famous Parisian cabaret with its dynamic composition. It features the popular dancer La Goulue and her partner Valentin le Désossé, captured in Lautrec's distinctive, energetic style.
items.tags: poster, cabaret, Montmartre, Belle Époque, lithography, nightlife, entertainment, Parisian

items.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
items.description_narrative: Gustave Caillebotte's 'Paris Street; Rainy Day' captures a striking urban scene in 1877 Paris, depicting well-dressed figures strolling under umbrellas on a wet street. The composition offers a unique perspective of modern city life, characterized by its precise realism and distinctive viewpoints.
items.tags: urban life, street scene, rainy day, 19th century, realism, city, umbrellas, french art

items.title: Discobolus
items.description_narrative: Myron's iconic Discobolus captures an athlete in the moment before releasing a discus, showcasing the ideal of physical prowess and dynamic tension. Though the original bronze is lost, its form is preserved through numerous Roman marble copies, illustrating the artistic and athletic ideals of classical Greece.
items.tags: ancient greek, sculpture, athlete, classical art, idealized form, movement, human form, roman copy

items.title: Water Lily Pond
items.description_narrative: Claude Monet's "Water Lily Pond" captures the shimmering surface of the artist's garden pond at Giverny, a subject he repeatedly explored. Through vibrant brushstrokes, Monet meticulously renders the interplay of light, water, and vegetation, creating an immersive atmospheric effect.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, garden, impressionism, landscape, nature, serene, painting

items.title: The Slave Ship
items.description_narrative: J. M. W. Turner's 'The Slave Ship' vividly captures the raw power of the sea amidst a tumultuous sky. The painting dramatically illustrates the tragic practice of throwing enslaved individuals overboard, symbolizing the brutality of the slave trade.
items.tags: slavery, maritime, romanticism, sublime, abolition, tragedy, seascape, oil painting

items.title: Breezing Up (A Fair Wind)
items.description_narrative: This iconic American painting depicts four figures in a dory battling a choppy sea under a strong breeze. The dynamic composition and realistic portrayal capture the excitement and challenge of maritime life.
items.tags: sailing, marine art, American realism, dory, ocean, seascape

items.title: Aristide Bruant dans son cabaret
items.description_narrative: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec frequently depicted the vibrant world of Parisian nightlife, immortalizing performers like Aristide Bruant. This iconic poster captures Bruant's distinctive stage persona, serving as both an advertisement and a lasting image of Belle Époque entertainment.
items.tags: parisian nightlife, cabaret, poster art, aristide bruant, performer, post-impressionism, belle époque

items.title: The Death of Socrates
items.description_narrative: Jacques Louis David's monumental 1787 oil painting depicts the final moments of Socrates as he prepares to drink hemlock. Surrounded by his devoted students, Socrates remains stoic, pointing skyward in a gesture of philosophical defiance.
items.tags: socrates, classical, philosophy, death, neoclassicism, history painting, stoicism, sacrifice

items.title: The Monk by the Sea
items.description_narrative: This iconic painting by Caspar David Friedrich depicts a small, solitary monk gazing out at a vast, turbulent sea under an expansive, dark sky. The stark contrast between the human figure and the overwhelming natural world evokes a profound sense of awe, isolation, and spiritual contemplation.
items.tags: landscape, romanticism, sublime, solitude, sea, contemplation, German art, melancholic

items.title: The Supper at Emmaus
items.description_narrative: Caravaggio powerfully depicts the dramatic moment Christ reveals himself to two disciples in Emmaus, capturing their astonished reactions. The artist masterfully employs intense chiaroscuro and lifelike figures, drawing the viewer into this profound biblical scene.
items.tags: religious, baroque, chiaroscuro, realism, dramatic, biblical, italian
